scope: One run per profile; two profiles use previously seen cachetools source. The schedule corpus was frozen before its first model call. No causal effect, model-training holdout or general recall claim.

cases.sourceReview: LRU and FIFO explanations cite the full module and correctly describe Cache/_DefaultSize coupling, validation, class-definition-time bindings, recency and replacement behavior. Key builders name their supplied tuple/sentinel helpers. The locked helper correctly states that its full module context is absent and that duplicate concurrent computations remain possible.

cases.sourceReview: Five candidates cover cache policy, argument-key policy and memoization. The LRU explanation names the Cache base and _DefaultSize, correctly handles missing-key overrides and cites supplied module evidence. The locked helper's missing context remains explicit. Neither test paths nor the supplied Cache test excerpt become a passing-test claim.
cases.limits: One known-source diagnostic per prompt. The old prompt also succeeds with the improved context; this does not isolate or establish a statistical benefit from the diversity instruction.

cases.sourceReview: Scheduler correctly distinguishes due execution from replaying missed intervals and describes copied-list run_all, tag filtering, cancellation markers and missing Job construction/execution. Weekday adjustment retains same-day behavior and names its supplied exception hierarchy. The format parser is an enclosed method needing adaptation; it catches only ValueError. Repeat returns the original decorated function and delegates registration to an unsupplied do implementation.
cases.limits: The complete Job class and module context remain absent, although individual Job method snippets are supplied. No upstream scheduler, helper, test or consumer was executed.

decision: Keep bounded coverage-v3 context ordering and the distinct-capabilities-v1 instruction. Preserve the prior LRU miss, public declaration ordering and older prompts for replay. Missing full context remains a visible extraction gate.
nextQuestion: Large single-file modules still exceed the bounded packet. Measure scoped supporting-definition evidence or targeted follow-up without treating partial context as complete.
